ordered_diagnoses: Primary lipoidal degeneration of the cornea
shortlist: Primary lipoidal degeneration of the cornea

selector.runner_up: Primary lipoidal degeneration of the cornea
selector.rationale: Peripheral cornea showed posterior crocodile shagreen and the presence of 4 symmetric concentric ring-shaped opacities in posterior corneal stroma supports this diagnosis

rejected.label: Fuchs endothelial dystrophy
rejected.why: No mention of corneal edema or significant endothelial changes

rejected.label: Corneal iron deposition
rejected.why: Normal serum iron levels and no evidence of iron deposits in the cornea

rejected.label: Corneal amyloidosis
rejected.why: No evidence of amyloid deposits in the cornea, and the ring opacities do not match the typical description of amyloidosis
